newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kelon in JV to make energy saving fridges.
newsitem.headline: Kelon in JV to make energy saving fridges.

text.p: China's Guangdong Kelon Electrical Holdings Co Ltd said on Thursday it has formed a joint venture company with two mainland partners to manufacture energy saving refrigerators.
The joint venture - Chengdu Kelon Refrigerator Co Ltd - was formed with Pearl River Electrical Refrigerator Co Ltd, a unit of Kelon, and Chengdu Engine Company, the statement said.
The new company would manufacture chlorofluorocarbon-free energy saving refrigerators with capacity of over 200 litres.
The new venture costs 240 million yuan and would be onstream in the first quarter of 1998 with an annual production capacity of about 500,000 refrigerators.
